reason: A DeepSeek Harness web plugin that expands attachment support through document text extraction, OCR, format conversion, image rendering, and long-document workspace indexing.

summaries.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 扩展 PDF、Office、文本和多种图像附件的解析、OCR、格式转换及长文档索引能力。
summaries.en: A DeepSeek Harness plugin that adds parsing, OCR, format conversion, image rendering, and long-document indexing for PDFs, Office files, text, and other attachments.

capabilities: Accepts PDF, Office, text, image, EPUB, ODT, RTF, and TIFF attachments
Extracts text and tables from documents
Converts and renders document formats into Markdown or PNG
Stores oversized attachment content and metadata in the session workspace
Can send document pages to configured Baidu OCR, vision-model, or external document-parser services
Can invoke local conversion tools including Python, Tesseract, Pandoc, LibreOffice, and system binaries
